verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page lists the ability to "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA", and EFILE filers can view their transmission history after signing in. Both are first-party status-tracking capabilities, but they sit behind authenticated accounts rather than public pages. Each gets only a one-line mention, with no detail on application or case status. Missing for 10: status lookup from public, unauthenticated pages; documented status for BN/program-account applications and cases; any detail on status stages or timelines; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
